correctness.rationale: Exact backward equations and positive absorption-time solution verify the three rational formulas. Fixing x+y=C cancels variable denominators, yielding second derivative -2/[ab(a+b+C)]<0 for all positive rates and every independent initial mixture, and projection onto [0,C] proves unique global optimality with exact squared-distance gap. The packaged independent Fraction Gauss-Jordan checker verified 576 CTMC systems, 8,640 weighted expectations, 960 optimization profiles and 8,640 exact grid inequalities. Boundary cases x=0,C and arbitrary positive unequal extinction rates were included; no finite test is substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two-patch occupancy chain is the smallest natural setting permitting unequal habitat loss and two directed rescue channels. Conservation allocation of a fixed total colonization effort is a mathematically motivated decision problem. The theorem gives a complete all-parameter unique optimizer and sharp interior/boundary policy phase diagram, reveals exact symmetry at full occupancy despite rate heterogeneity and directional bang-bang decisions after a single source start, and provides an exact quantitative loss certificate. It is a structural management result rather than a one-off computed number; transfer to real systems requires the stated assumptions.
